reason: The README clearly describes a local read_document tool that converts common office, ebook, tabular, and PDF files into paged, line-numbered Markdown for model inspection.

summaries.zh: 将 Word、PowerPoint、Excel、OpenDocument、RTF、EPUB、CSV 和 PDF 文件转换为可分页读取的带行号 Markdown。
summaries.en: Converts Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF files into line-numbered Markdown that can be read in pages.

capabilities: Reads supported local document files through the harness filesystem interface
Converts Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, and PDF files to line-numbered Markdown
Supports PDF page selection and reports pages without extractable text
